cc65816.version: Calypsi ISO C compiler for 65816 version 5.18
Calypsi ISO C compiler for 65816 version 5.18

pin.scope: Shell keyboard bridge plus host pacing only after completed video frames; guest CPU/peripheral timing is unchanged.

peripherals.name: happy-none
peripherals.firmware: built-in high-level model; quiet command only

observer.mode: same binary, EXEC816_LATENCY_TRACE and EXEC816_MASK_TRACE environment gates; replay with both unset

keyboard_input.mode: POKEY matrix scan; PushRawKey/ReleaseRawKey immediate=false; modifier matrix transitions
keyboard_input.initialization: KEY ALL up enables scan mode before modifier changes

observer.scope: Passive full-address CPU markers, POKEY timestamps and I-flag transitions between emulator microstates; no guest instructions/cycles added
observer.build_options: Same as toolchain/altirra-build.json, build/latency target AltirraBridgeServer
observer.resolution: I transitions sampled between CPU microstates, including RTI followed immediately by IRQ. 1/8 base-cycle timestamps at 8x; includes NMI/ROM/DMA elapsed time. Not a hardware worst-case guarantee.

observations.scope: Four-task diagnostic TX pump under concurrent kernel work; no production driver or RX

native_completion.scope: Elapsed time under serial/port load; root may already be runnable; not a worst-case hardware guarantee

masked.scope: CPU I=1 intervals during first SEROUT write through final byte completion
masked.resolution: Observed between emulator microstates, including RTI-to-immediate-IRQ transitions; 1/8 base-cycle timestamps. Includes NMI/ROM/DMA time, not a hardware worst-case guarantee.
